dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Bilateral internuclear ophthalmoplegia from bilateral paramedian pontine lacunar infarctions secondary to diabetic small-vessel disease

Alternatives:
1. Multiple sclerosis causing bilateral MLF lesions (less likely given age, vascular risk factors, and infarction on imaging)
2. Myasthenia gravis with fatigable diplopia (less likely given normal pupil/slit-lamp, no ptosis, and definite infarcts on MRI)
3. Wernicke encephalopathy with brainstem involvement (less likely without history of alcoholism, malnutrition, or ataxia)
